parameters.name: withDouble
parameters.description: Enable 64 bits floating point (32 bits always enabled)

parameters.name: asyncRegFile
parameters.description: Implement the register file using combinatorial reads (instead of syncronous reads)

parameters.name: mulWidthA
parameters.description: Specify the width of the left operand of multiplication blocks

parameters.name: mulWidthB
parameters.description: Same than above but the the right operand

parameters.name: catchAccessFault
parameters.description: When true, an instruction read response with read error asserted results in a CPU exception trap.

parameters.name: resetVector
parameters.description: Address of the program counter after the reset.

parameters.name: cmdForkOnSecondStage
parameters.description: When false, branches immediately update the program counter. This minimizes branch penalties but might reduce FMax because the instruction bus address signal is a combinatorial path. When true, this c

parameters.name: cmdForkPersistence
parameters.description: When false, requests on the iBus can disappear/change before they are acknowledged. This reduces area but isn't safe/supported by many arbitration/slaves. When true, once initiated, iBus requests will

parameters.name: compressedGen
parameters.description: Enable RISC-V compressed instruction (RVC) support.

parameters.name: busLatencyMin
parameters.description: Specifies the minimal latency between the iBus.cmd and iBus.rsp. A corresponding number of stages are added to the frontend to keep the IPC to 1.

parameters.name: injectorStage
parameters.description: When true, a stage between the frontend and the decode stage of the CPU is added to improve FMax. (busLatencyMin + injectorStage) should be at least two.

parameters.name: prediction
parameters.description: Can be set to NONE/STATIC/DYNAMIC/DYNAMIC_TARGET to specify the branch predictor implementation. See below for more details.

parameters.name: historyRamSizeLog2
parameters.description: Specify the number of entries in the direct mapped prediction cache of DYNAMIC/DYNAMIC_TARGET implementation. 2 pow historyRamSizeLog2 entries.

parameters.name: relaxedPcCalculation
parameters.description: When false, branches immediately update the program counter. This minimizes branch penalties but might reduce FMax because the instruction bus address signal is a combinatorial path. When true, this c

parameters.name: config.cacheSize
parameters.description: Total storage capacity of the cache in bytes.

parameters.name: config.bytePerLine
parameters.description: Number of bytes per cache line

parameters.name: config.wayCount
parameters.description: Number of cache ways

parameters.name: config.twoCycleRam
parameters.description: Check the tags values in the decode stage instead of the fetch stage to relax timings

parameters.name: config.asyncTagMemory
parameters.description: Read the cache tags in an asynchronous manner instead of syncronous one

parameters.name: config.addressWidth
parameters.description: CPU address width. Should be 32

parameters.name: config.cpuDataWidth
parameters.description: CPU data width. Should be 32

parameters.name: config.memDataWidth
parameters.description: Memory data width. Could potentialy be something else than 32, but only 32 is currently tested

parameters.name: config.catchIllegalAccess
parameters.description: Catch when a memory access is done on non-valid memory address (MMU)

parameters.name: config.catchAccessFault
parameters.description: Catch when the memeory bus is responding with an error

parameters.name: config.catchMemoryTranslationMiss
parameters.description: Catch when the MMU miss a TLB

parameters.name: catchIllegalInstruction
parameters.description: When true, instructions that don't match a decoding specification will generate a trap exception

parameters.name: regFileReadyKind
parameters.description: Can be set to ASYNC or SYNC. Specifies the kind of memory read used to implement the register file. ASYNC means zero cycle latency memory read, while SYNC means one cycle latency memory read which can

parameters.name: zeroBoot
parameters.description: Load all registers with zeroes at the beginning of the simulation to keep everything deterministic in logs/traces

parameters.name: bypassExecute
parameters.description: Enable the bypassing of instruction results coming from the Execute stage

parameters.name: bypassMemory
parameters.description: Enable the bypassing of instruction results coming from the Memory stage

parameters.name: bypassWriteBack
parameters.description: Enable the bypassing of instruction results coming from the WriteBack stage

parameters.name: bypassWriteBackBuffer
parameters.description: Enable the bypassing of the previous cycle register file written value

parameters.name: separatedAddSub
parameters.description: By default SRC_ADD/SRC_SUB are generated from a single controllable adder/substractor, but if this is set to true, it use separate adder/substractors

parameters.name: executeInsertion
parameters.description: By default SRC1/SRC2 are generated in the Decode stage, but if this parameter is true, it is done in the Execute stage (It will relax the bypassing network)

parameters.name: earlyInjection
parameters.description: By default the result of the shift is injected into the pipeline in the Memory stage to relax timings, but if this option is true it will be done in the Execute stage

parameters.name: earlyBranch
parameters.description: By default the branch is done in the Memory stage to relax timings, but if this option is set it's done in the Execute stage

parameters.name: catchAddressMisaligned
parameters.description: If a jump/branch is done in an unaligned PC address, it will fire an trap exception

parameters.name: genMul
parameters.description: Enables multiplication support. Can be set to false if you want to use the MulPlugin instead

parameters.name: genDiv
parameters.description: Enables division support

parameters.name: mulUnrollFactor
parameters.description: Number of combinatorial stages used to speed up the multiplication, should be > 0

parameters.name: divUnrollFactor
parameters.description: Number of combinatorial stages used to speed up the division, should be > 0

parameters.name: readOnly
parameters.description: When true (default), mstatush is read-only. When false, writes are accepted but have no effect.

parameters.name: ioRange
parameters.description: Function reference which eat an address and return true if the address should be uncached. ex : ioRange= _(31 downto 28) === 0xF => all 0xFXXXXXXX will be uncached

parameters.name: debugClockDomain
parameters.description: As the debug unit is able to reset the CPU itself, it should use another clock domain to avoid killing itself (only the reset wire should differ)

parameters.name: externalFpu
parameters.description: When false the FPU is instanciated in Vex, else the plugin has a `port` interface to which you can connect an external FPU

parameters.name: p
parameters.description: Parameter with which the connected FPU will be created
